facts: Peace Be Still is an iPhone app for the end of the day, made by Spry Labs; it is on the App Store now.
It opens with one question, What do you need tonight?, and two doors: God's Word and Mindset.
The God's Word door has the whole King James Bible to read, and nearly every chapter read aloud, Bible chat, a daily Bible story and whispered Psalms for sleep.
Bible chat is AI, labelled as AI, and quotes verses word for word from stored King James text.

Its journeys include Hush Harbor (Black Bible chat and stories), Mi Refugio (Bible and chat in Spanish, Reina-Valera 1909), Psalm Nights (whispered scripture for sleep), Morning Word (daily declarations) and Young Faith (a Bible for teens).

The free version is free for good: the whole King James Bible to read, nearly every chapter read aloud, today's story, one chat a day of up to 5 messages, the first sleep night and then one a week, and the daily declaration.
The paid plan costs $7.99 a month or $39.99 a year; there is no free trial, no weekly plan and no ads, and you can cancel any time from a link on the paid screen.
lacks: Peace Be Still is not on Google Play or Android yet.
Peace Be Still has no free trial.
Peace Be Still does not have pictures or faces of people.
Peace Be Still does not treat, cure or heal sleep problems or anxiety, and it is not medical advice.
Peace Be Still does not use the Reina-Valera 1960, the NIV, the ESV or the NLT.
